name: timeplus-theme
description: Build and test tooling for the TimePlus Typecho theme

scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map --style=expanded assets/sass/main.scss assets/css/main.css && sass --no-source-map --style=expanded assets/sass/noscript.scss assets/css/noscript.css && sass --no-source-map --style=expanded assets/sass/timeplus-enhancements.scss assets/css/timeplus-enhancements.css
scripts.check:js: node --check assets/js/main.js && node --check assets/js/timeplus-gallery.js && node --check assets/js/timeplus-enhancements.js && node --check assets/js/util.js
